title: Meet the Boat Before You Book
why: Behind-the-scenes for planners who want to know what they are booking: the boat, the safety routine, what is provided.
hook_options: What is actually on the boat?
Here's everything on board before you book.
The boring stuff that makes the party work.
caption: What is on board, what the crew checks before you leave the dock, and what you never have to think about. Roof, bathroom, speaker, captain. You bring the cooler. #HoustonPartyBarge #ClearLake #Seabrook #HoustonBoatParty

slides.headline: Meet the boat before you book it.
slides.body: What is on board, what the crew checks, and what you never have to think about.

slides.headline: 30 feet. Up to 26 guests.
slides.body: Big enough for the whole crew. Small enough that nobody gets stranded at the far end of the party.

slides.headline: A roof and a bathroom. Not extras.
slides.body: Texas sun plus a 1 hour 45 minute cruise. We built for both.

slides.headline: The boat moves itself.
slides.body: It's fully motorized and a licensed captain drives the whole time. Your only job is the playlist.

slides.headline: Certified, not just floating.
slides.body: Coast Guard certified boat, licensed captain on every cruise. Safety is the floor, not the sales pitch.

slides.headline: Waivers, head count, weather check.
slides.body: Every waiver ties to your booking. The captain counts heads and checks the forecast again before leaving the dock.

slides.headline: 26 means 26.
slides.body: Life jackets on board for everyone. Capacity is a hard cap. Not 27. Not just one more.

slides.headline: Speaker and party lights, ready to go.
slides.body: Connect your phone at the dock. The lights earn their keep once the sun drops.

slides.headline: Boat, captain, crew. You bring the rest.
slides.body: Cooler, snacks, playlist, people. That's the whole list.

slides.headline: Now you've seen it. Come ride it.
slides.body: Public cruises and private charters out of Seabrook. houstonpedalbarge.com
